__README: Committed config for monday-sync.js. NOT secret - only MONDAY_TOKEN is a secret. Board 'Dorotape Dev Tracker' was created via the API with these exact ids. Boards are named '<Project> Dev Tracker' so they sort together and read as pipeline boards rather than client work. Nothing in the code reads the board NAME - only boardId - so renaming a board never breaks the pipeline. After ANY change to the board, run: node .github/scripts/monday-sync.js check
__columnTypes: Each column must be the TYPE listed here, not merely exist - check verifies this and refuses mismatches. ref=Text, status=Status, branch=Text, pr=Link, commit=Text, deployedAt=Date, deployResult=Status, checksResult=Status, lastRun=Link, size=Status, weight=Numbers. Any of them may be null, which means 'this board does not have that column' - the write is skipped and check reports it as optional rather than missing. Do not point two entries at one column id; check rejects that too, because those writes would overwrite each other.
__branchAndCommit: Both deleted from this board on 2026-07-31 and set to null here: the PR link already leads to the branch and the commits, so two extra columns of developer detail were noise on a board other people read. The pipeline is unchanged - it still takes --branch and --commit on the command line, it just no longer writes them to the board. Re-add them by creating Text columns and pasting the ids back.
__boardSetup: Status labels must match 'labels' below exactly - 'In progress' is lowercase p, and a mismatch fails loudly rather than inventing a label. The token's user needs a MEMBER seat; a viewer seat reads fine and fails every write. To rediscover ids: node .github/scripts/monday-sync.js discover --board 18424565446
__statusIndex5: If you ever rebuild a Status column, leave label index 5 EMPTY. monday treats index 5 as the column's blank slot, so any label sitting there is what every unset item reports - the first build of this board put 'QA' at index 5 and every new ticket read as already in QA while its stored value was still null. check refuses to pass if index 5 is occupied. The index is not visible in the UI; only the API shows it.
__timezone: Only affects the human-readable stamp in comments. The 'Deployed at' COLUMN is always stored in UTC and monday renders it in each viewer's own profile timezone, so set this to match yours (monday profile: Africa/Johannesburg) or the comment and the column will disagree by an hour. Comments always name the zone, so a teammate in another zone can still read them.
__size: Both created by setup-progress on 2026-07-31, which places the Size labels at explicit indexes and leaves 5 free - do NOT add sizes through the monday UI, it chooses the index for you and a label at 5 makes every unsized ticket report that size (see __statusIndex5). Set either to null to turn progress reporting off; the command then skips instead of failing. To rebuild on another board: setup-progress, then paste the ids it prints.
__progress: Drives the weighted progress bar. It is written to two places, each switched off independently: boardDescription (false to skip) is the text box under the board title - always on screen, notifies nobody, holds no history; itemName (empty string to skip) is a row on the board, so its updates reach people's feeds and stack up as a record of every change. Keep both unless one is noise for this project. weights maps Size labels to points - the gaps are deliberate and near-Fibonacci, so nobody argues over a 3 versus a 4 and an XL reads as eight small jobs rather than 'a bit more than L'. doneLabels and onDevLabels are reported as SEPARATE figures, never added together: Completed is set by hand after sign-off, so counting only that shows a build at 20% when most of it is finished and waiting on QA, while counting dev as done tells a client something is finished that nobody has checked. excludedLabels takes abandoned work out of the denominator; without it the bar can never reach 100%, because a cancelled ticket keeps its Size forever. Cancelled was added to this board's Status column on 2026-07-31 and sits at index 9.
__devUrl: The dev site URL is NOT here. It is the DEV_SITE_URL repo variable (or a gitignored .env locally), because it points at an environment - a copy of this repo for another project must not inherit the old URL. This file describes the board only.
